reason: A DSH mobile companion that provides remote browser access over Tailscale, mobile-oriented status and notifications, remote workspace registration, and connection-based Windows wakefulness.

summaries.zh: 通过 Tailscale 将 DSH Web 界面提供给手机浏览器，并在移动布局中显示会话状态、通知及远程工作区操作。
summaries.en: Provides mobile browser access to a DSH Web profile over Tailscale with session status, in-page notifications, and remote workspace actions.

capabilities: Provides a mobile browser interface for DSH
Exposes the local DSH web profile through Tailscale Serve
Shows in-page task and action notifications
Registers and opens local workspaces from entered paths
Sends heartbeat requests and prevents Windows sleep while connected
